snippet.title: Foreverthorn // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3918930/Foreverthorn/

Foreverthorn is a shooter game where you blast, kick and EXPLODE grim, thorny monsters. Explore the dungeons of Rose Chapel, find useful items and collect roses for your wife's grave.

Developed by 
FoxthornDev
